episode_title: Thomas Vick and Seth Wilson on Clio's New AI Tools for Law Firms

real_qa.q: What new AI features did Clio announce at ClioCon for law practice management?
real_qa.r: Clio announced Clio Phones, a native business phone system integrated into Clio with call recording, transcription, and summarization capabilities that can extract tasks and prepare time entries automatically. The company also integrated its CRM system (formerly Clio Grow) into Clio Manage under a single login, along with Grow AI, an automated AI agent that answers calls and performs matter intake off-hours.
real_qa.requete: Clio new AI features ClioCon announcement

real_qa.q: How does Clio Phones use AI to improve call handling in law firms?
real_qa.r: Clio Phones can record calls (subject to jurisdiction compliance), transcribe and summarize conversations, extract action items like follow-up appointments or document requests, create tasks automatically, and prepare time entries based on call duration, all attached to the relevant matter with access to contact information and client data.
real_qa.requete: Clio Phones AI call transcription law firm

real_qa.q: What is the paradigm shift in how lawyers interact with AI tools like Clio?
real_qa.r: The shift moves from attorneys directly performing tasks to instructing AI through a single point of entry, much like directing staff. Lawyers now supervise AI output rather than create work themselves, requiring better communication of requirements and ongoing feedback so the AI learns preferences and improves with each iteration.
real_qa.requete: AI paradigm shift lawyer supervision single point entry

real_qa.q: What challenges arise from using Clio's Grow AI for automated client intake?
real_qa.r: Key concerns include distinguishing between helping clients and providing unauthorized legal advice through the AI agent, managing lead qualification accuracy to avoid miscategorizing legitimate leads as spam, and determining where the line is between calendaring/scheduling assistance and legal advice, requiring careful scoping and human oversight policies.
real_qa.requete: Grow AI automated intake unauthorized practice law risks

real_qa.q: How does AI integration in law practice affect attorney knowledge retention and case preparation?
real_qa.r: Using AI tools may reduce instant recall of case facts and family member details because information flows through the AI system, but AI also enables rapid research on unfamiliar legal areas—Thomas Vick described completing secured interests research in 10 minutes that felt equivalent to a law school exam, allowing attorneys to refresh recollection quickly before client consultations.
real_qa.requete: AI law practice knowledge retention case facts research

He practices primarily as a transactional attorney in estate planning and rarely appears in courtrooms. He has experience implementing AI tools in his law practice and actively discusses legal technology trends and their impact on law firm operations.
